title: PnP Community Pets: Badge/Logo Library Manifest
description: Drop this file in your badge folder under media/badges/<your-badge>/badge.json

id.description: Unique ID for this badge. Defaults to the folder name if omitted.

name.description: Display name shown in the badge/sign picker.

description.description: One-line description shown in the badge/sign picker.

imageFile.description: Filename of the badge/logo image (transparent PNG recommended), relative to this folder.

linkUrl.description: Optional URL opened when the sign is clicked, e.g. a Credly badge page or event site.
